newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FX FUTURES MKT FOCUS ON BASKET DEALS, BUBOR.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FX FUTURES MKT FOCUS ON BASKET DEALS, BUBOR.

text.p: Hungary's currency futures market continued to focus on dollar/mark basket deals on Thursday, while three-month BUBOR rate futures traded in an unusally high volume on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE).

'The dollar/mark basket deals seem to be the only safe deals," said Mihaly Eotvos of OTP Forex Alkusz, adding that the Swiss franc have been too volatile in the past six weeks, while a cut in the monthly devaluation rate to one percent on August 15 provided the market with a good factor to trade on.
BCE basket deals concentrated on the December maturity.
The dollar close at 197.31 for December, up 26 fillers, while the mark dropped 15 fillers to 115.80.
Thursday's 6200 lots in mark and 2015 lots in dollar accounted for more than half of the BCE currency section's trading volume of 15,347 lots, or 4.236 billion forints.
Three-month BUBOR rates rose 20 basis points to 19.70 for September, trading in an unusally high turnover of 6,262 lots, which traders could not explain.
Currency futures settlement prices on the Budapest Stock Exchange remained unchanged and only two deals were made in a total turnover of 715 million forints, for December 1998 mark, at 130 forints.
